Supreme Court Faces Contempt Plea Over Delhi Metro Closures

A contempt petition has been filed in the Supreme Court alleging arbitrary metro station closures and train cancellations in Delhi, despite a court order. The plea specifically targets the Delhi Police chief. The closures and cancellations are linked to protests, with the Centre for Public Interest Litigation (CJP) being mentioned in relation to the protest.
